name: Jesus

Jesus states that the pain started after he attempted lifting a heavy piece of furniture yesterday. Since onset of the pain, he also noticed that maintaining his balance has been more difficult and that he has been stumbling more. Jesus also endorses that the pain is even more severe when he attempts to bend or stretch his back. When you examine Jesus, you notice that he is tender to palpation in the mid-thoracic spine, and that he has a positive Romberg sign.
